annotationRationale: Shared-altitude applications of the triangle area formula produce the factors three and nine. A complete partition then combines the seven triangle areas.
sourceMethod: Followed the first official method, using shared-altitude area comparisons. Described the auxiliary segments and the partition in words so no source diagram is needed.

review.mathCheck: Shared-altitude comparisons give three 3X triangles and three 9X triangles. Each surrounding sector splits into one of each, and these sectors together with ABC partition the outer triangle. Its area is X+3(3X+9X)=37X, giving 37:1, choice E.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Originally worded expansion of official solution #15's first approach. The named triangles, added segments, and 3X/9X regions agree with the supplied official diagram.
review.annotationCheck: The explanation identifies the complete partition and its disjoint interiors, making the area sum reconstructible without the official figure.
